question: How is the enzyme adenylyl cyclase activated ?:

options.opa: By interacting directly with membrane receptors activated by its ligand.
options.opb: By interacting directly with Gsα subunits that have previously bound GTP.
options.opc: By interacting directly with Gsα subunits that have previously bound GDP.
options.opd: By interacting directly with the cyclic AMP (cAMP) produced by the Gsα subunits.
